task.title: Calibrate static analysis entrypoints
task.summary: Make PyLens/Knip-style review inputs aware of CodeWiki package entrypoints, public API facades, scripts, and tests.

goal.outcome: Future dead-code review output no longer flags known package entrypoints and script surfaces as unused.
acceptance: Static analysis configuration or package metadata declares Pi extension, public API facade, CLI scripts, and test files as entrypoints.
Dynamic script import usage such as scripts/codewiki-gateway.mjs is visible to the tool or documented as an intentional ignore.
Review evidence shows known runtime/package entrypoints are not reported as dead code, or each remaining false positive has an explicit rationale.
Package smoke and pack checks remain compatible.
non_goals: Do not delete exports based only on the current review.
Do not handle UI asset dependency calibration; the UI task owns control-room asset behavior.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
